description: This file contains a Java class 'Xfermodes' that demonstrates the use of various PorterDuff transfer modes with bitmaps and canvas drawing operations on Android. It includes helper methods for creating sample bitmaps and a custom View to perform the drawing and demonstrate different blending modes.

classes.name: Xfermodes
classes.description: Main activity class demonstrating transfer modes using custom views in Android.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: Inner class extending View that performs the drawing of sample bitmaps with different PorterDuff modes.

methods.name: makeDst
methods.description: Creates a bitmap with an oval shape for use as the destination image in blending modes.

methods.name: makeSrc
methods.description: Creates a bitmap with a rectangle for use as the source image in blending modes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Android activity lifecycle method, sets the content view to an instance of SampleView.

methods.name: SampleView
methods.description: Constructor that initializes bitmaps, shaders, and prepares the view for drawing.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Overrides View's onDraw method to render the demonstration of various transfer modes.
